assertions: ModelContainer is a Sendable class backed by an explicit async mutex; actor reentrancy alone is not exclusive access across await.
Container generation holds exclusive context only around startup/prefill, not an entire returned stream; separate workers permit concurrent generations.
Cancellation before entering next differs from cancellation during an already-entered next; source test records one token then finalization before join.
Caller-owned mutable caches/arrays are not made safe for arbitrary sharing; evaluate and respect actual Sendable/transfer ownership, without inventing a public synchronize method.
